items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Michelle Bernard bought it from Eddie Victor. I was playing that for Eddie Victor.

ctx.x: was the name of it? Do you remember? Any special name on it or just the boss's name? Oh, it

was, uh, Bernard's, uh, Cafe. That was the name of it. Well, Eddie Victor had it before Michelle Bernard. Michelle Bernard bought it from Eddie Victor. I was playing that for Eddie Victor. And when he came in and he heard the band, behind the place, he was checking every night he'd come around, you know, he heard the band. He asked me would I accept the job. He told me to come out and see him next day. So I went out to his house and saw him. And we got together. We made a nice agreement. Told me, he says, anytime…
